jobs.title: Sales Manager_South China
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of junior sales staff, ensuring daily sales operations run smoothly, and supporting the achievement of sales targets. This role provides coaching, monitors performance, and ensures compliance with company policies. Key Responsibilities

• Develop pump services sales in south of China and achieve the sales target.

• Supervise daily activities of the sales team.

• Assign tasks and monitor progress toward goals.

• Ensure adherence to sales processes and policies.

• Handle customer issues and escalate when necessary.

• Track and report team performance.

• Support implementation of sales initiatives.

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and 5+ years of sales experience in pumps industry are minimally required.

• Good knowledge on pump technology and experience with pump service sales is preferred.

• Experience in sales or customer service supervision.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Familiarity with CRM systems and sales reporting.

• Problem-solving and organizational abilities.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil.

In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.

• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)

• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).

• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;

• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;

• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.

• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;

• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)

• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role

• Excellent English. German and French are an asset

• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential

• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity

• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment

• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable.

What we offer you

• Attractive compensation and vacation plan

• Excellent social benefits

• Global development opportunities

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation

• Employee Assistance Program

• Long service awards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Lab Technician - Fractional Crystallization Research & Applications Descrizione Sulzer, un'azienda di ingegneria leader con una solida tradizione di innovazione, cerca un Tecnico di Laboratorio per unirsi al nostro team di Ricerca e Applicazioni della Cristallizzazione Frazionata ad Allschwil. In questo ruolo emozionante, pianificherai ed eseguirai trial per i clienti e supporterai attivamente i progetti di ricerca e sviluppo interni. Condurrai diverse attività pratiche in campo R&D per migliorare la sostenibilità nell'industria chimica e sviluppare tecnologie future. Compiti e Responsabilità - Pianificazione, esecuzione, valutazione e relazione di trial per i clienti (dalla scala del banco alla scala del pilota). - Responsabile per le tecnologie analitiche. Garantisce l'implementazione di nuovi metodi e l'operabilità dei dispositivi corrispondenti durante la sperimentazione, inclusa la calibrazione, la preparazione dei campioni e le misurazioni, nonché la formazione per le parti interessate. - Supporto attivo ai progetti di R&D interni: pianificazione, esecuzione e relazione di vari test secondo le esigenze. - Lavoro in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni dell'azienda. - Responsabile per la gestione del laboratorio (pulizia e ordine) e del magazzino dei prodotti chimici (smaltimento e conservazione dei prodotti chimici secondo le classi di stoccaggio e i pericoli). - Rispetta e rispetta le misure ESH appropriate e la "buona pratica di laboratorio" durante il lavoro quotidiano. Contribuisci attivamente alla gestione del cambiamento e alle valutazioni dei rischi. Rispetta i regolamenti sulla sicurezza e le procedure di qualità, segnala gli incidenti e gli incidenti. Tieni presenti gli aspetti LEAN nel lavoro. - Commissione occasionale presso il sito dei clienti in Svizzera e all'estero. - Supporta e partecipa all'implementazione della strategia di digitalizzazione della tecnologia e dell'innovazione (T&I). - mantenere e migliorare le attrezzature per i test, supportare la progettazione dei processi. - Esegui ulteriori compiti assegnati dal responsabile diretto.
• Requisiti - Diploma di tecnico di laboratorio/chimico (apprendistato, titolo tecnico) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile - Inglese eccellente. Tedesco e francese sono un vantaggio - Capacità di priorizzare i compiti, forte senso dell'organizzazione, forte passione per il lavoro di laboratorio, capacità di organizzare il lavoro in modo indipendente, orientamento al team e al cliente Cosa offerta - Retribuzione attraente e piano delle vacanze - Eccezionali benefici sociali - Opportunità di sviluppo a livello globale - Cultura innovativa, vivace e agile - Parcheggio gratuito e accessibilità con i mezzi pubblici - Programma di Assistenza ai Dipendenti - Premi per la lunga permanenza Sulzer è un'azienda che offre pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di un team di lavoro diversificato e siamo impegnati a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere stati riconosciuti come "Miglior datore di lavoro" nel 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Purpose of the job
Supports CAE activities for ORE, PD and CT projects globally. Compilation of mechanical analysis documentation provided to clients, proving the mechanical, rotordynamic and structural integrity of products, ensuring conformity to established industry, company standards and customer specifications

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Rotordynamic analysis (Lateral and Torsional) of centrifugal pumps.

• Pump design calculations as per international standards.

• Structural and Dynamic analysis of Baseplate and Vertical Pump using ANSYS Workbench

• Preparation & submission of calculation reports and coordinating for customer approvals.

• Provide technical assistance to project team to solve possible discrepancies & review and issue and follow-up the comments on reports, specifications, etc.

• Making design recommendations to provide acceptable rotordynamic level, behavior of pump and help to resolve difficult or unusual product design engineering problems.

• Capable of performing routine mechanical engineering calculations and analysis.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Relevant experience in Rotating machine industry practices & standards.

• Experience in finite element analysis techniques and calculations

• Experience of rotor dynamics, FEA using Ansys

• Solid understanding of structural mechanics fundamentals and basic vibration

• Knowledge of in 2D/3D CAD & PLM software

• Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, word and power point

• Knowledge of Industry Code & Standards such ASME, EN, API, etc

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

 Communication skills
 Relationship management skills
 Customer service skills
 Time management skills
 Ability to act independently
 Flexibility and ability to adapt to change
 Attention to detail
 Meet quality objectives set and KPIs

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: ASM2 - tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. On time Submission of tenders
• Techno commercially optimum and competitive offers
• On time submission and closure of technical clarifications, Technical bid clarification meeting as required
• Clear handover of the project to project team after order, attending ORM
• Close project open points if any and attend customer KOM if required
• Analyze RFQs, tenders, and bid documents for centrifugal pumps (API 610, ISO, ANSI, API 610 / ISO 5199 / ISO 2858 / client specs)
• horizontal/vertical, multistage, etc.)
• Basic Knowledge for Bought out items like, Mechanical Seal & Seal Plan, Motors, Lube Oil System
• Prepare commercial offers , BOQ-based pricing, and option sheets.
• Co-ordinate with Procurement for bought‑out items, factory for delivery timelines & Sales for commercial terms and margins.
• Provide pre‑bid clarifications and participate in technical discussions
• Support sales teams during during Negotiations & Pre- Bid technical Justifications
• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting
• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

What we offer you

• 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Hospitalization insurance benefit
• On-site car parking
• Subsidized cafeteria
• Long service award

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, testing, and maintenance, and recommending new equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
• Provide technical support to the Sales and Tendering teams throughout the bidding process.

• Review pump selections prepared by the Tendering team to ensure technical compliance and optimization.

• Review and interpret client specifications, particularly for critical or special requirements.

• Coordinate with the Design Responsible (DR) team to obtain additional technical inputs and solutions.

• Interact directly with customers to understand specific application needs and incorporate them into the design layout.

• Liaise with suppliers to resolve technical queries and obtain necessary clarifications.

• Coordinate with other Sulzer legal entities (SPUK, SPDE, SPSZH, SPUSA) to obtain technical support and share expertise.

• Provide technical assistance to the Costing department during the bidding stage.

• Prepare preliminary Pump General Arrangement (GA) drawings for customer submission.

• Estimate “not‑to‑exceed” dimensions based on pump selection and buyout drawings.

• Coordinate with Order Engineering teams (Hydraulics, Bare Pump, Packaging, Instrumentation, Electrical, etc.) to address special or non‑standard requirements.

• Support and collaborate with Operations, Purchase, Sales, and Tendering teams during technical evaluations.

• Proactively support company initiatives that promote safe working practices, environmental protection, and continuous improvement.

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Procurement Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer GT Aero (formerly Alba Power) is a global leader in gas turbine maintenance, repair and overhaul, supporting critical energy infrastructure worldwide. Now part of Sulzer’s renowned rotating equipment services business, we combine decades of engineering expertise with a strong focus on supply chain excellence, partnering with suppliers to deliver quality, cost efficiency and reliability at scale.

We are currently looking for a Procurement Administrator to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to support a high-performing procurement function, managing supplier data, processing purchase orders and helping ensure smooth, efficient supply chain operations. Ideal for someone organised, detail-focused and keen to build a career in procurement within a global engineering business. Job Responsibilities

• Process purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.

• Maintain and update supplier information, including contact details, pricing agreements, and performance records.

• Assist in the preparation of Request for Quotations (RFQs) and Request for Proposals (RFPs), circulating them to potential suppliers.

• Track and expedite orders, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving any supply chain issues or delays.

• Generate procurement reports, including spend analysis, supplier performance, and inventory levels.

• Support the negotiation of favorable terms and conditions with suppliers.

Job Qualifications

• Proven experience in an administrative or support role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.

• Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to task completion.

• Knowledge of procurement principles and practices is a plus.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer GT Aero (formerly Alba Power) is a global leader in gas turbine maintenance, repair and overhaul, supporting critical energy infrastructure worldwide. Now part of Sulzer’s renowned rotating equipment services business, we combine decades of engineering expertise with a strong focus on supply chain excellence, partnering with suppliers to deliver quality, cost efficiency and reliability at scale. We are currently looking for a Procurement Administrator to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to support a high-performing procurement function, managing supplier data, processing purchase orders and helping ensure smooth, efficient supply chain operations. Ideal for someone organised, detail-focused and keen to build a career in procurement within a global engineering business. Job Responsibilities
• Process purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.
• Maintain and update supplier information, including contact details, pricing agreements, and performance records.
• Assist in the preparation of Request for Quotations (RFQs) and Request for Proposals (RFPs), circulating them to potential suppliers.
• Track and expedite orders, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving any supply chain issues or delays.
• Generate procurement reports, including spend analysis, supplier performance, and inventory levels.
• Support the negotiation of favorable terms and conditions with suppliers. Job Qualifications
• Proven experience in an administrative or support role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.
• Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is highly desirable.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to task completion.
• Knowledge of procurement principles and practices is a plus. What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Company-wide bonus scheme
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. jobs.title: Serviceleder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi trives best med flere baller i luften, i et arbeidsmiljø hvor kreativitet og rasjonalitet går hånd i hånd. Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt.
Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

• Teknisk nysgjerrighet

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk.
Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri.

Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt. Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss! Stillingen inneholder blant annet:
• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.
• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.
• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.
• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.
• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.
• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.
• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang. Hovedoppgaver Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:
• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.
• Personalansvar for teknikerne
• Kundekontakt og befaringer
• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet
• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt
• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner. Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning
• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse
• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende
• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr
• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.
• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt
• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg
• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk
• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)
• Gode kunnskaper innen IT Personlige styrker
• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer
• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team
• Kundeorientert
• Teknisk nysgjerrighet What we offer you Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk. Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri. Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

jobs.title: Internal Quality Auditor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The entry-level Internal Quality Auditor is responsible for the execution of day-to-day quality assurance activities. This includes setting operational objectives, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and resolving routine quality issues. Key Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain QESH management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.

• Ability and willingness to travel to Service Centers across the US 5-7 times per year.

• Conduct internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments across production areas.

• Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and track corrective actions.

• Provide training and guidance to employees on QESH policies and safe work practices.

• Monitor and report on QESH KPIs, including non-conformities, near misses, and environmental metrics.

• Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing efforts

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate QESH into daily operations.

• Maintain documentation and prepare for external audits and customer inspections.

• Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory quality standards.

• Investigate and resolve routine quality issues.

• Support audits and continuous improvement initiatives

Requirements:

• Intermediate knowledge of MS Word MS Excel required

• Basic knowledge or MS SharePoint and MS PowerPoint preferred

• 1+ years of experience in Internal Quality Audits preferred but not required

• Knowledge of quality assurance practices and tools.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

• Effective communication and documentation abilities.

• Familiarity with manufacturing environments.

• Experience in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 environments preferred

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer Industry
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.

This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities

• Assist in preparing and delivering technical presentations.

• Support the development of customized solutions based on client needs in the area/customers of responsibility.

• Process the orders so Order entry people can transfer the order to factories.

• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure feasibility of proposals.

• Respond to customer inquiries and provide technical support.

• Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions.

​ Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Strong interest in technology and sales.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM tools.

• Team player with a proactive mindset.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer Chemtech, a global leader in mass transfer, static mixing, and polymer solutions for the chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, and LNG industries. We drive innovation in separation and purification technologies, including sustainable solutions for biopolymers and recycling.

We’re seeking a Regional Sales Manager – South Region with an entrepreneurial mindset to grow our Mass Transfer Components business in Canada. You’ll lead sales efforts, build strong client relationships, and deliver tailored solutions that enhance customer success. This role offers the opportunity to shape a dynamic territory. Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of process industries with world-class technology and a commitment to innovation and environmental responsibility.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Drive Growth : Own and grow order intake and profitability across the assigned region by executing strategic sales initiatives and uncovering new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and market analysis.

• Execute a World-Class Sales Process : Manage the entire sales cycle — from lead generation to closing — using CRM tools to maintain accurate forecasts, document customer visits, and track opportunities through all sales stages.

• Engage Clients with Technical Expertise : Deliver customized technical presentations and collaborate with internal Application Engineering and Field Services teams to develop tailored solutions across sectors including Refinery, Upstream, Chemical, and Carbon Capture.

• Build Strategic Relationships : Develop and maintain long-term partnerships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring continued business growth and customer satisfaction.

• Navigate Commercial Complexities : Assess and mitigate risks related to contracts, pricing, and terms by interfacing with Legal, Accounting, and other internal departments to ensure commercially sound deals.

• Stay Ahead of the Curve : Monitor competitor activity and industry trends, attend trade shows and conferences, and regularly report on territory performance to support agile sales strategies.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Hunter Mentality : You are a strategic go-getter who knows how to identify and engage the ideal customer. You bring a creative approach to building relationships, with real-world examples of how you've done it before.

• Growth-Driven Mindset : You excel at mapping markets, identifying white space, and developing actionable strategies to break into new customer segments. You’re as comfortable developing marketing initiatives as you are closing deals.

• Tenacity and Drive : You’re motivated by targets and not afraid to roll up your sleeves. You proactively chase new opportunities while seamlessly collaborating with Application and Technical teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.

• Strong Commercial Acumen : With 5+ years in a front-line sales role, you’ve mastered the art of the sale — from lead generation to closing. You know contracts, negotiate with confidence, and keep your CRM forecasts sharp and accurate.

• Customer Excellence : You’re authentic, approachable, and easy to work with — someone customers enjoy talking to and trust. Your commitment to service creates long-term partnerships that fuel sustained growth.

• Industry-Proven Experience : You bring at least five years of success selling industrial equipment or services in oil & gas or related sectors, with a solid track record selling.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Unisciti a Sulzer Chemtech, leader globale nel trasferimento di massa, nella miscelazione statica e nelle soluzioni polimeriche per le industrie chimiche, petrolchimiche, raffinazione e LNG. Noi guidiamo l'innovazione nelle tecnologie di separazione e purificazione, comprese le soluzioni sostenibili per i biopolimeri e il riciclaggio. Stiamo cercando un Regional Sales Manager – Regione del Sud con una mentalità imprenditoriale per crescere il nostro business Mass Transfer Components in Canada. Potrai condurre gli sforzi di vendita, costruire forti relazioni con i clienti, e fornire soluzioni su misura che migliorano il successo del cliente. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di plasmare un territorio dinamico. Unisciti a noi e fai parte di una società che modella il futuro delle industrie di processo con la tecnologia di livello mondiale e l'impegno per l'innovazione e la responsabilità ambientale. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Crescita dell'azionamento: Possedere e aumentare l'assunzione di ordini e la redditività in tutta la regione assegnata eseguendo iniziative strategiche di vendita e scoprendo nuove opportunità di business attraverso la prospettiva, la rete e l'analisi del mercato.
• Eseguire un processo di vendita di classe mondiale: gestire l'intero ciclo di vendita — dalla generazione di piombo alla chiusura — utilizzando strumenti CRM per mantenere previsioni accurate, documentare le visite dei clienti e monitorare le opportunità attraverso tutte le fasi di vendita.
• Coinvolgere clienti con competenza tecnica: fornire presentazioni tecniche personalizzate e collaborare con i team interni di Application Engineering e Field Services per sviluppare soluzioni su misura in settori tra cui raffineria, a monte, chimica e carbon Capture.
• Costruire relazioni strategiche: sviluppare e mantenere partnership a lungo termine con i clienti chiave e gli stakeholder, garantendo una crescita continua del business e la soddisfazione del cliente.
• Navigare Complessità Commerciali: Valutare e mitigare i rischi relativi a contratti, prezzi e termini, interfacciandosi con Legale, Contabilità e altri dipartimenti interni per garantire offerte commercialmente solide.
• Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitorare l'attività dei concorrenti e le tendenze del settore, partecipare a fiere e conferenze, e regolarmente riferire sulle prestazioni del territorio per sostenere le strategie di vendita agili. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Hunter Mentality: Sei un go-getter strategico che sa identificare e coinvolgere il cliente ideale. Porti un approccio creativo alla costruzione di relazioni, con esempi reali di come l'hai fatto prima.
• Mindset guidato dalla crescita: eccellete nei mercati di mappatura, identificando lo spazio bianco e sviluppando strategie attuabili per entrare in nuovi segmenti dei clienti. Sei come confortevole sviluppare iniziative di marketing come si sta chiudendo accordi.
• Tenacità e unità: sei motivato da obiettivi e non hai paura di arrotolare le maniche. Inseguite proattivamente nuove opportunità collaborando senza soluzione di continuità con i team applicativi e tecnici per fornire soluzioni orientate al cliente.
• Acume commerciale forte: con 5+ anni in un ruolo di vendita di prima linea, hai imparato l'arte della vendita — dalla generazione di piombo alla chiusura. Conoscete i contratti, negoziate con fiducia e tenete le vostre previsioni CRM affilate e accurate.
• Eccellenza del cliente: Lei è autentico, accessibile e facile da lavorare con — qualcuno i clienti godono di parlare e di fiducia. Il vostro impegno per il servizio crea partnership a lungo termine che alimentano una crescita sostenuta.
• Esperienza industriale-proven: porti almeno cinque anni di successo vendendo attrezzature industriali o servizi in settori petroliferi o correlati, con una solida vendita record. Nessun visto o permesso di lavoro può essere fornito per questo
descriptionByLocale.en:

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. Join Sulzer Chemtech, a global leader in mass transfer, static mixing, and polymer solutions for the chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, and LNG industries. We drive innovation in separation and purification technologies, including sustainable solutions for biopolymers and recycling. We’re seeking a Regional Sales Manager – South Region with an entrepreneurial mindset to grow our Mass Transfer Components business in Canada. You’ll lead sales efforts, build strong client relationships, and deliver tailored solutions that enhance customer success. This role offers the opportunity to shape a dynamic territory. Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of process industries with world-class technology and a commitment to innovation and environmental responsibility. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Drive Growth : Own and grow order intake and profitability across the assigned region by executing strategic sales initiatives and uncovering new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and market analysis.
• Execute a World-Class Sales Process : Manage the entire sales cycle — from lead generation to closing — using CRM tools to maintain accurate forecasts, document customer visits, and track opportunities through all sales stages.
• Engage Clients with Technical Expertise : Deliver customized technical presentations and collaborate with internal Application Engineering and Field Services teams to develop tailored solutions across sectors including Refinery, Upstream, Chemical, and Carbon Capture.
• Build Strategic Relationships : Develop and maintain long-term partnerships with key clients and stakeholders, ensuring continued business growth and customer satisfaction.
• Navigate Commercial Complexities : Assess and mitigate risks related to contracts, pricing, and terms by interfacing with Legal, Accounting, and other internal departments to ensure commercially sound deals.
• Stay Ahead of the Curve : Monitor competitor activity and industry trends, attend trade shows and conferences, and regularly report on territory performance to support agile sales strategies. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Hunter Mentality : You are a strategic go-getter who knows how to identify and engage the ideal customer. You bring a creative approach to building relationships, with real-world examples of how you've done it before.
• Growth-Driven Mindset : You excel at mapping markets, identifying white space, and developing actionable strategies to break into new customer segments. You’re as comfortable developing marketing initiatives as you are closing deals.
• Tenacity and Drive : You’re motivated by targets and not afraid to roll up your sleeves. You proactively chase new opportunities while seamlessly collaborating with Application and Technical teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
• Strong Commercial Acumen : With 5+ years in a front-line sales role, you’ve mastered the art of the sale — from lead generation to closing. You know contracts, negotiate with confidence, and keep your CRM forecasts sharp and accurate.
• Customer Excellence : You’re authentic, approachable, and easy to work with — someone customers enjoy talking to and trust. Your commitment to service creates long-term partnerships that fuel sustained growth.
• Industry-Proven Experience : You bring at least five years of success selling industrial equipment or services in oil & gas or related sectors, with a solid track record selling. No visa or work permit support can be provided for this
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Sulzer Chemtech, ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Massentransfer-, statischen Misch- und Polymerlösungen für die Chemie-, Petrochemie-, Raffinerie- und LNG-Industrie. Wir treiben Innovation in Trenn- und Reinigungstechnologien, einschließlich nachhaltiger Lösungen für Biopolymere und Recycling. Wir suchen einen Regional Sales Manager – South Region mit einer unternehmerischen Denkweise, um unser Geschäft mit Mass Transfer Components in Kanada zu erweitern. Sie leiten Vertriebsbemühungen, bauen starke Kundenbeziehungen auf und liefern maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die den Kundenerfolg steigern. Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, ein dynamisches Gebiet zu gestalten. Begleiten Sie uns und sind Teil eines Unternehmens, das die Zukunft der Prozessindustrie mit erstklassiger Technologie und ein Engagement für Innovation und Umweltverantwortung prägt. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben:
• Wachstum vorantreiben: Eigener und wachsender Auftragseingang und Rentabilität in der gesamten Region, indem strategische Vertriebsinitiativen durchgeführt und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten durch Prospektion, Vernetzung und Marktanalyse entdeckt werden.
• Durchführung eines World-Class-Verkaufsprozesses: Verwalten des gesamten Verkaufszyklus – von der Lead-Generation bis zum Abschluss – mit CRM-Tools, um genaue Prognosen zu erhalten, Kundenbesuche zu dokumentieren und Chancen durch alle Verkaufsstufen zu verfolgen.
• Kunden mit technischer Expertise : Liefern Sie kundenspezifische technische Präsentationen und arbeiten Sie mit internen Teams von Application Engineering und Field Services zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen in allen Bereichen wie Raffinerie, Upstream, Chemical und Carbon Capture zu entwickeln.
• Aufbau strategischer Beziehungen: Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Schlüsselkunden und Interessenvertretern, die ein kontinuierliches Wachstum und Kundenzufriedenheit gewährleisten.
• Navigieren Sie Handelskomplexe : Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Verträgen, Preisen und Konditionen durch Einschaltung von Rechts-, Rechnungswesen und anderen internen Abteilungen, um kommerziell fundierte Geschäfte zu gewährleisten.
• Überwachen Sie die Konkurrenztätigkeit und die Branchentrends, besuchen Sie Messen und Konferenzen und melden Sie regelmäßig über die Leistungsfähigkeit des Territoriums, um agile Vertriebsstrategien zu unterstützen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• Hunter Mentalität: Sie sind ein strategischer Go-Gitter, der weiß, wie man den idealen Kunden identifiziert und engagiert. Sie bringen einen kreativen Ansatz, um Beziehungen aufzubauen, mit realen Beispielen, wie Sie es zuvor getan haben.
• Growth-Driven Mindset: Sie zeichnen sich durch die Mapping-Märkte aus, identifizieren weißen Platz und entwickeln handlungsfähige Strategien, um in neue Kundensegmente zu brechen. Sie sind so bequem, Marketing-Initiativen zu entwickeln, wie Sie Deals schließen.
• Tenacity and Drive : Sie sind von Zielen motiviert und haben keine Angst, Ihre Ärmel hochzurollen. Sie verfolgen proaktiv neue Möglichkeiten und arbeiten nahtlos mit Application und Technical Teams zusammen, um kundenorientierte Lösungen zu liefern.
• Starke kommerzielle Acumen: Mit 5+ Jahren in einer vorgelagerten Verkaufsrolle haben Sie die Kunst des Verkaufs gemeistert – von der Lead-Generation bis zum Abschluss. Sie kennen Verträge, verhandeln mit Vertrauen und halten Ihre CRM Prognosen scharf und genau.
• Customer Excellence : Sie sind authentisch, ansprechbar und einfach zu arbeiten — jemand, der mit dem Gespräch und Vertrauen genießt. Ihr Engagement für den Service schafft langfristige Partnerschaften, die nachhaltiges Wachstum fördern.
• Industrie-Proven-Erfahrung: Sie bringen mindestens fünf Jahre Erfolg Verkauf von Industrieanlagen oder Dienstleistungen in Öl- und Gas- oder verwandten Sektoren, mit einem soliden Track Record-Verkauf. Ein Visum oder eine Arbeitsgenehmigung kann hierfür nicht vorgesehen werden

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Rejoignez Sulzer Chemtech, leader mondial dans les solutions de transfert de masse, de mélange statique et de polymères pour les industries chimiques, pétrochimiques, de raffinage et de GNL. Nous réalisons l'innovation dans les technologies de séparation et de purification, y compris des solutions durables pour les biopolymères et le recyclage. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur régional des ventes – région du Sud avec un esprit d'entreprise pour développer notre entreprise de composants de transfert de masse au Canada. Vous dirigerez les efforts de vente, établirez de solides relations avec les clients et offrirez des solutions adaptées qui améliorent le succès des clients. Ce rôle offre la possibilité de façonner un territoire dynamique. Rejoignez-nous et faites partie d'une entreprise qui façonne l'avenir des industries de transformation avec une technologie de calibre mondial et un engagement envers l'innovation et la responsabilité environnementale. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:
• Favoriser la croissance : Prospection, mise en réseau et analyse du marché : prise de commandes et rentabilités propres et croissantes dans toute la région désignée.
• Exécuter un processus de vente de classe mondiale : gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente — de la génération de plomb à la fermeture — en utilisant les outils CRM pour maintenir des prévisions précises, documenter les visites des clients et suivre les opportunités à travers toutes les étapes de vente.
• Mobiliser les clients avec une expertise technique : offrir des présentations techniques personnalisées et collaborer avec des équipes internes d'ingénierie d'application et de services sur le terrain pour développer des solutions adaptées à tous les secteurs, y compris la raffinerie, Upstream, Chemical et Carbon Capture.
• Établir des relations stratégiques : Développer et maintenir des partenariats à long terme avec les principaux clients et parties prenantes, en assurant la croissance continue des affaires et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
• Naviguer dans les complexités commerciales : évaluer et atténuer les risques liés aux contrats, aux prix et aux modalités en interférant avec les services juridiques, comptables et autres services internes pour assurer des transactions commercialement saines.
• Stay Ahead of the Curve : Surveiller l'activité des concurrents et les tendances de l'industrie, assister à des salons et conférences, et rendre compte régulièrement des performances sur le territoire pour soutenir des stratégies de vente agiles. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Mentalité de Hunter : Vous êtes un voyeur stratégique qui sait identifier et engager le client idéal. Vous apportez une approche créative pour construire des relations, avec des exemples du monde réel de la façon dont vous l'avez fait avant.
• Growth-Driven Mindset : Vous excellez sur les marchés de la cartographie, l'identification de l'espace blanc et le développement de stratégies actionnables pour percer de nouveaux segments de clients. Vous êtes aussi à l'aise pour développer des initiatives de marketing que vous fermez des affaires.
• Tenacity and Drive : Vous êtes motivé par des cibles et n'avez pas peur de vous retrousser les manches. Vous recherchez proactivement de nouvelles opportunités tout en collaborant de façon transparente avec les équipes Application et Technique pour fournir des solutions axées sur le client.
• Strong Commercial Acumen : Avec 5 ans et plus dans un rôle de vente en première ligne, vous avez maîtrisé l'art de la vente — de la génération de plomb à la fermeture. Vous connaissez les contrats, négociez avec confiance et gardez vos prévisions CRM précises et précises.
• Excellence client : Vous êtes authentique, accessible et facile à travailler avec, quelqu'un aime parler et faire confiance. Votre engagement envers le service crée des partenariats à long terme qui favorisent une croissance soutenue.
• Expérience éprouvée par l'industrie : Vous apportez au moins cinq ans de succès dans la vente d'équipements ou de services industriels dans le secteur du pétrole et du gaz ou dans les secteurs connexes, avec une solide expérience de vente. Aucun visa ou permis de travail ne peut être fourni pour cela

jobs.description:

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key

Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.

Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.

Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

target bonus:18.33% of annual income

jobs.title: APT Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Application Engineering Lead is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, conducting technical analysis of product configurations, and ensuring customer-specific solutions meet technical and commercial requirements. This role includes preparing and delivering technical briefings, estimating costs and resources, and supporting implementation.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Prepare technical and commercial quotations; attend technical presentation and clarification meeting; technical appendix negotiation; attend commercial bidding and order negotiation, contract preparation / negotiation and risk control
• 2. Monitor / update project status in system regularly
• 3. Market Analysis and business promotion when needed
• 4. Internal handover meeting preparation
• 5. Assistant to attend column start up, plant test run and trouble shooting
• 6. Follow ISO procedure and Office 5s maintenance
• 7. Other tasks assigned by APT Manager/Team leader
• REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE
1. Minimum 1-3 years’ work experience as chemical engineer / plant engineer / process engineer in refinery, coal chemicals, environmental, petrochemicals, fine & specialty chemicals plant, with plant operation and DCS control practices will be more appreciated, or 1-3 years’ work experience as process engineer in engineering company in above mentioned market
• 2. Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, Master's degree is preferred
• 3. Fluent in both oral & written English and Mandarin
• 4. Fluent use MS office such as WORD /EXECL /PowerPoint
• 5. Fluent use simulation software such as Pro-II or Aspen would be additional benefit
• 6. Customer oriented, Teamwork in mind, Strong committed to achieve results
• 7. Positive attitude, Open-minded, Good communication skills
• 8. Ready to work under pressure. Available for frequent traveling
• 9. Awareness to work in an international environment

jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior E&I Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Senior E&I Engineer, you will participate at the Sulzer projects execution at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support and et.) within discipline and responsible.
Senior E&I Engineer reports to the Chief E&I Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Execute detail engineering of instrument design for process plant modular skids, including wiring line diagrams, instruments, panel and PLC control specifications.

• Prepare technical specifications for inquiry, issuing requisition for instruments, related items and subcontracting work.

• Preparation and design of Piping and Instrumentation Diagram, in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Preparation of process plant operating control philosophy, including alarm and interlocking trip matrix in conjunction with Process Engineers

• Develop SIS, SIF and SIL

• Participate in HAZOP for process plant

• Review and approve subcontractor engineering documents, including instrument calculation, selection and PLC programming subcontractor.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Technical support for costing of skid projects.

• Support receiving inspection of project E&I items.

• Technical support for workshop skid assembly.

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management between disciplines

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Electrical/ Instrumentation Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Good knowledge of skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Supervisor is responsible for supervising procurement professionals and ensuring the effective sourcing and acquisition of goods and services. This includes managing supplier relationships and ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. The Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

Depending on workload, this position will be assigned to functions in the Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management and Advanced Procurement function. The role works closely with all cross‑functional teams across the organization, supporting their sourcing needs to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and quality‑compliant delivery aligned with project and business objectives.

A background in EPC environments is an advantage, along with experience in site procurement, construction, or working within an engineering‑driven setting. Exposure to international procurement is also a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Senior Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Senior Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English
Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system.
- Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling.
- Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline).
- Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability.
- Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution.
- Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective.
- Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture.
- Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions.
- Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete.
- Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

What we offer you

target bonus：15% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities: - Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system. - Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling. - Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline). - Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability. - Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution. - Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective. - Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture. - Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions. - Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete. - Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors. 
• What we offer you target bonus：15% of annual income Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Focus on Guangxi &Guizhou province business.
- Dig more inquiry for TAS &Revamping project, organize technical presentation or clarification meeting if needed, attend commercial bidding and price negotiation. Contract detail up.
- Maintain good relationship with customers, continuous enhance market share.
- Manage, guide customers and achieve area targets and results by synergy together with other area sales
- Visit customer timely by providing technical advice and proposal.
- Providing sales forecast and visit &Lost reports; Update weekly plan and execute accordingly to make sure clear target.
- Fight plan for key project and good at seeking opportunity.
- Attend sales meeting & internal training for self-improvement
- Co-ordinate with Procurement, Engineering, Workshop etc departments for
products delivery to perfect Sales’ KPI.
- Provides timely feedback to senior manager for assigned task
- Other tasks by GM, Head of sales or High Management assigned.

What we offer you

target bonus：25% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
