jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key 
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

What we offer you

target bonus:18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Process Engineering Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Process Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising expert-level engineers in the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role ensures operational efficiency and supports continuous improvement initiatives.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. Résumé du poste**

En tant que Superviseur Ingénierie des Procédés, vous serez responsable de l'optimisation, de la gestion et de la supervision des processus de fabrication au sein de notre usine, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et la sécurité.

Responsabilités**

* Superviser et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens en procédés.
* Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser des processus de fabrication pour améliorer la productivité, réduire les coûts et garantir la qualité des produits.
* Analyser les données de production et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration continue des processus.
* Élaborer et maintenir la documentation technique des procédés, y compris les schémas de tuyauterie et d'instrumentation (P&ID), les procédures opérationnelles standard (SOP) et les instructions de travail.
* Participer à la sélection, à l'installation et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements de production.
* Assurer la conformité des processus aux normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité (ISO, etc.).
* Collaborer étroitement avec les départements de production, de maintenance, de R&D et de qualité.
* Gérer les projets d'amélioration des procédés, y compris la planification, le suivi du budget et le respect des délais.
* Former et développer les compétences de votre équipe.

Qualifications**

* Diplôme d'ingénieur en génie des procédés, génie chimique, mécanique ou domaine connexe.
* Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie des procédés dans un environnement industriel, avec une expérience significative en supervision ou gestion d'équipe.
* Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies d'optimisation des procédés (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.).
* Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse technique.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe dans un environnement dynamique.
* Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais technique (écrit et oral).
* Connaissance des logiciels de simulation de processus (par exemple, Aspen Plus, HYSYS) serait un plus.
* Expérience dans l'industrie des pompes, de la compression ou de l'équipement rotatif serait un atout.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximizing enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Ensure that defined long-term and short-term objectives, strategies and plans are achieved.

• Follow-up regularly on submitted proposals and to update in Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Co-ordinate projects with Head Office, Regional Offices and Agents, as applicable.

• Provide regular reporting on market, projects, market analysis and sales forecasts.

• Ensure that all business activities conform to local laws and regulations and are following company policies and procedures.

• Any other duties that are assigned by superiors.

Competencies and behaviour required

• Frequent travel to domestic customers

• Fluent in written & spoken English in addition to local language

• Excellent interpersonal skills, initiative and proactive.

• Good communicator and good leadership skills.

• · Good negotiation, planning, coordination & monitoring skills.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from reputable university.

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Oil & Gas / Oleochemical Industry.

• Proven track record in achieving YoY (Year on Year) sales growth with strong penetration and success in Indonesia Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical segment.

• Strong network of established contacts with decision makers / influencers in end user and engineering companies from Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals & Oleochemical market will be advantageous.

• Experience working with international, multi-ethnic and cultural teams.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Saving Plan
Medical Benefit

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, specialising in OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industrial applications. This site brings together cutting-edge engineering capability, digital design, and high-precision manufacturing, supporting sectors such as energy, water, chemicals, and infrastructure.

With significant recent investment, our Leeds operations are evolving rapidly—enhancing our capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing, and product innovation. jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Aero Mechanic is responsible for the safe coordination of assembly and disassembly of all aero derivative machinery. They inspect and diagnose malfunctions and reliably fix machinery in compliance with safety regulations. Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble power turbines, gas generators, and accessory gear associated with aeroderivative machinery

• Possess a proficient knowhow of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments.

• Continuously gain knowledge of products, materials, and procedures to better perform duties including updating safety processes.

• Keep the work areas clean and well-organized during disassembly, inspection, assembly, and when the job is completed.

• Be ready to travel to job site when called with tools and safety equipment.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• Hands-on shop and/or field service experience in aero-derivative turbomachinery repair.

• Technical knowledge of aero-derivative turbomachinery repair.

• 4+ years of aeroderivative machinery experience is preferred but not required.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics

titleByLocale.it: Senior Finanza Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.en: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.de: Senior Finanzen Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Finance Business Partner to support our Services business across the UK & Nordics region. In this strategic role, you will combine deep financial expertise with strong business acumen to guide decision‑making, improve performance, and ensure financial insights are embedded at every level of the organisation.

As a key partner to regional leadership, you will play a critical part in shaping the future direction of the business - helping drive sustainable growth, profitability, and operational excellence across multiple sites and service lines.

The role can be based at our Birmingham or Leeds facilities.

What you’ll do:

• Develop and review strategic plans at a regional, business unit, or divisional level, providing financial insights to support long-term growth and business strategies

• Establish and maintain comprehensive performance management frameworks for cross-functional and geographically diverse teams

• Manage major capital programs and oversee costing, pricing and profitability modelling.

• Partner with senior leaders, shaping strategy and ensuring financial alignment with business goals.

• Support project reviews and provide expert financial guidance through the full project lifecycle.

What you’ll bring:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or similar.

• 7–10 years’ experience in leadership in finance or business planning, ideally within the industrial, engineering services or manufacturing sectors.

• Strong stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence senior decision‑makers.

• Excellent communication skills, translating complex financial insights for non‑financial audiences.

• Advanced MS Office skills; experience with Tagetik, Qlik Sense or ERP systems is a plus.

What we offer you

• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

If you're a strategic thinker with strong business acumen and a passion for partnering with leadership to drive performance, we’d love to hear from you.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Finance Business Partner commercialmente pensato per supportare il nostro business Servizi in tutta la regione del Regno Unito & Nordics. In questo ruolo strategico, si combinano competenze finanziarie profonde con un forte acume aziendale per guidare il processo decisionale, migliorare le prestazioni e garantire che gli insight finanziari sono incorporati a ogni livello dell'organizzazione. Come partner chiave per la leadership regionale, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione della direzione futura del business - aiutando a guidare la crescita sostenibile, la redditività e l'eccellenza operativa in più siti e linee di servizio. Il ruolo può essere basato presso le nostre strutture Birmingham o Leeds. Cosa farai:
• Sviluppare e rivedere piani strategici a livello regionale, aziendale o divisionale, fornendo informazioni finanziarie per sostenere la crescita a lungo termine e le strategie aziendali
• Stabilire e mantenere un quadro completo di gestione delle prestazioni per i team interfunzionali e geograficamente diversi
• Gestire i principali programmi di capitale e supervisionare la modellazione dei costi, dei prezzi e della redditività.
• Partner con leader senior, strategia di modellazione e allineamento finanziario con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Sostenere le recensioni dei progetti e fornire una guida finanziaria esperta attraverso il ciclo di vita del progetto completo. Cosa porterai:
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o simili.
• Esperienza di 7-10 anni nella leadership nella finanza o nella pianificazione aziendale, idealmente all’interno dei servizi industriali, ingegneristici o industriali.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di influenzare i decisori senior.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, traducendo complesse intuizioni finanziarie per il pubblico non finanziario.
• Avanzate competenze di MS Office; l'esperienza con Tagetik, Qlik Sense o sistemi ERP è un plus. Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo e guidare la strategia globale
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• pacchetto di stipendio competitivo con benefici attraenti, regime pensionistico e programma di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Eccitanti opportunità di crescita e di progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione. Se sei un pensatore strategico con un forte acume aziendale e una passione per la collaborazione con la leadership per guidare le prestazioni, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen kaufmännischen Senior Finance Business Partner, der unser Services-Geschäft in der gesamten Region Großbritannien & Nordics unterstützt. In dieser strategischen Rolle kombinieren Sie fundierte finanzielle Expertise mit starkem Geschäft, um Entscheidungsfindung zu führen, die Leistung zu verbessern und die finanziellen Einsichten auf jeder Ebene der Organisation zu gewährleisten. Als zentraler Partner für die regionale Führung werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Gestaltung der zukünftigen Geschäftsrichtung spielen – dabei helfen Sie nachhaltiges Wachstum, Profitabilität und operative Exzellenz über mehrere Standorte und Servicelinien hinweg. Die Rolle kann auf unseren Einrichtungen in Birmingham oder Leeds basieren. Was du tun wirst:
• Entwicklung und Überprüfung strategischer Pläne auf regionaler, geschäftlicher oder sektoraler Ebene, die finanzielle Einblicke zur Unterstützung langfristiger Wachstums- und Geschäftsstrategien bieten
• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung umfassender Leistungsmanagement-Frameworks für funktions- und geographisch unterschiedliche Teams
• Verwalten von Großkapitalprogrammen und Überwachung der Kosten-, Preis- und Rentabilitätsmodellierung.
• Partner mit leitenden Führungskräften, der Gestaltung der Strategie und der Sicherstellung der finanziellen Ausrichtung mit Geschäftszielen.
• Projektrezensionen unterstützen und durch den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus eine kompetente Finanzberatung bieten. Was Sie bringen werden:
• Abschluss in Finanzen, Buchhaltung, Betriebswirtschaft oder dergleichen.
• 7–10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Führung in der Finanz- oder Geschäftsplanung, ideal im Industrie-, Engineering- oder Fertigungssektor.
• Starke Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, ältere Entscheidungsträger zu beeinflussen.
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die komplexe finanzielle Einsichten für nichtfinanzielle Publikum übersetzen.
• Erweiterte MS Office-Fähigkeiten; Erfahrung mit Tagetik, Qlik Sense oder ERP-Systemen ist ein Plus. Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Chance, einen erheblichen Einfluss zu entfalten und die globale Strategie voranzutreiben
• Zusammenarbeit und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Schwerpunkt Innovation und Exzellenz.
• Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket mit attraktiven Leistungen, Pensionsregelung und Arbeitshilfeprogramm.
• Spannende Chancen für professionelles Wachstum und Wachstum in einer dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Industrie. Wenn Sie ein strategischer Denker mit starkem Business-Acumen und eine Leidenschaft für die Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung sind, um die Leistung zu steigern, würden wir gerne von Ihnen hören. Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und sind verpflichtet, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld anzubieten. Wir sind stolz, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Senior Finance Business Partner pour soutenir nos activités de Services dans la région du Royaume-Uni et des Nordiques. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous combinerez une expertise financière profonde avec un sens fort de l'entreprise pour guider la prise de décision, améliorer les performances et veiller à ce que les connaissances financières soient intégrées à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. En tant que partenaire clé du leadership régional, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'orientation future de l'entreprise - contribuant à stimuler la croissance durable, la rentabilité et l'excellence opérationnelle sur plusieurs sites et lignes de services. Le rôle peut être basé sur nos installations de Birmingham ou de Leeds. Ce que vous allez faire:
• Élaborer et examiner des plans stratégiques à l'échelle régionale, de l'unité opérationnelle ou de la division, en fournissant des informations financières pour appuyer la croissance à long terme et les stratégies d'affaires;
• Établir et tenir à jour des cadres complets de gestion des performances pour les équipes interfonctionnelles et géographiquement diverses
• Gérer les grands programmes d'immobilisations et superviser l'établissement des coûts, la tarification et la modélisation de la rentabilité.
• Établir des partenariats avec les hauts responsables, élaborer une stratégie et assurer l'alignement financier sur les objectifs opérationnels.
• Appuyer l'examen des projets et fournir des conseils financiers spécialisés tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. Ce que vous apporterez:
• Diplôme en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires, ou similaire.
• 7-10 ans d'expérience en leadership en finance ou en planification d'entreprise, idéalement dans les secteurs industriel, des services d'ingénierie ou de la fabrication.
• Des compétences solides en gestion des parties prenantes avec la capacité d'influencer les décideurs supérieurs.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, traduisant des perspectives financières complexes pour les publics non financiers.
• Compétences avancées MS Office; l'expérience avec les systèmes Tagetik, Qlik Sense ou ERP est un plus. Ce que nous vous offrons
• La chance d'avoir un impact significatif et de conduire la stratégie mondiale
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif et solidaire mettant l'accent sur l'innovation et l'excellence.
• Ensemble de salaires concurrentiels comportant des prestations attrayantes, un régime de retraite et un programme d'aide aux employés.
• Possibilités de croissance et d'avancement professionnels dans une industrie dynamique et en évolution. Si vous êtes un penseur stratégique avec un sens fort des affaires et une passion pour le partenariat avec le leadership pour conduire la performance, nous aimerions entendre de vous. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

jobs.title: Service Center Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Perform routine administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, and mail handling.
Support scheduling and meeting coordination.
Maintain office supplies and assist with logistics.
Follow instructions and escalate non-routine issues.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience to carry out the role.

Basic administrative and organizational skills.
Ability to follow instructions and procedures.
Familiarity with office tools and systems.
Willingness to learn and support team needs.

What we offer you

Country Benefits:

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Student or Intern is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large, Group organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Follow instructions and complete assigned duties.
Participate in training and development activities.
Support team members as needed.

POSITION: Mechanical Design Intern

DEPARTMENT: Product Engineering
SUPERVISOR: Supervisor Pump Design
SALARY GRADE: N/A
FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt
SUMMARY:

The Product Development (PD) group is involved in the design, validation and documentation of new product design and upgrades to existing product ranges. The successful candidate will work on project support as assigned by Engineers in the PD group.

Position is full-time during the summer.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
% OF TIME

Training will be given to accomplish the following:

· Hands-on support of component testing and data collection.
· Drafting support using NX 3D/2D system
· Engineering support work for projects as assigned
· Release of drawings / documents through SAP & Teamcenter ERP systems

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
· Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide ESG & EHS Management systems, which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.
· Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of freshman year of BSc Mechanical Engineering degree.
· Excellent interpersonal, communication and analytical skills.
· Sound computer skills in Word and Excel.
· Experience with 2D and 3D CAD systems
· An Interest in rotating machinery and manufacturing is beneficial.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Early Careers Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

​Company Overview:

Sulzer Services is an independent provider of services and equipment repairs for the Rotating Equipment industry. Sulzer Services specializes in the repairs and overhaul of gas turbines, steam turbines, compressors, pumps and electromechanical equipment for the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, and Power Generation industries.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Early Career Programs Specialist to develop and execute our internship and new-hire rotational programs. This role will also provide support to the Training Program Manager with strategic initiatives. Additional responsibilities include internal communications such as newsletters, program updates, department calendars, e-learning content creation, and designing promotional content for training programs. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience in designing, implementing, and evaluating developmental programs that provide emerging talent with meaningful learning experiences. This role requires a blend of project management, instructional design, and stakeholder collaboration to ensure program success and alignment with organizational goals. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Develop and execute comprehensive new hire rotational programs that align with organizational objectives and provide participants with structured learning experiences.

• Internship program: establish program and enhance for growth throughout the region and product lines.

• Work closely with department managers and HR to define program goals, identify skill gaps, and ensure alignment with business needs.

• Lead the recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and facilitating onboarding to integrate interns and new hire rotational employees effectively.

• Manage all logistical aspects of the programs, including scheduling, venue arrangements, coordinating with volunteers, and resource allocation.

• Monitor and assess program effectiveness through feedback, performance metrics, and evaluations to ensure continuous improvement.

• Assist the Training Program Manager in developing and implementing training strategies that align with organizational goals including but not limited to developing e-learning content, maintaining training calendars, and developing procedures.

• Maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring accurate entry and upkeep of training records, course schedules, and participant data.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Proven experience as a Program Coordinator or similar role, with a track record of coordinating comprehensive internship and rotational programs in a corporate environment.

• 3–5 years of experience in training and development, program coordinator, or a similar role.

• Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage timelines, logistics, and multiple stakeholders.

• High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, managers, and external partners.

• Proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning platforms.

• Ability to analyze data and assess the effectiveness of training programs.

• Familiarity with instructional design theory and adult learning principles.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Mot

jobs.title: Technical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Designs and delivers hands on mechanical training courses (1–2 weeks) that build foundational and advanced turbomachinery skills, guiding new hires through core concepts, job book exercises, and real-world inspection and assembly practices while evaluating their proficiency. Develops and continuously improves training curricula, materials, and programs to address skill gaps, enhance safety and productivity, and ensure effective onboarding and ongoing workforce upskilling. Responsibilities

• Leading novice mechanical training courses
• Helping to develop the next generation of mechanical talent within our organization
• Guiding groups through the critical job book exercises

• Teaching refined mechanical skills throughout the disassembly, inspection and reassembly stages of an overall

• Verifying an employee’s ability to apply measurement methods to real world inspection scenarios

• Guide new hires through basic terminology and turbomachinery overview

• Identify current and future training needs and create a curriculum to facilitate that training

• Refining and developing mechanical training materials
• Advancing the modules that have already been created

• Building out adjacent training modules for other equipment types

• Developing training aides for specialized tasks.

• Leading periodic advance mechanical upskilling training efforts

• Supporting aspects of new hire shop orientation

• Supporting occasional outage Production Supervision responsibilities/oversight

• Search for gaps in training content and materials that need updating to generate higher productivity and safety among staff

• Researching new training supplies and materials that can enhance Sulzer’s training procedures while providing value to employees

• Communicating with management, trainers, and team members to ensure that all training needs are met

• Conducting technical orientation programs and arranging on-the-job training for new hires as needed

• Resolving any specific problems and tailoring training programs as necessary

• Provide documentation of employees performance during training to supervision and upper management including aptitude, attitude, and academic performance.

• Maintain records from all training classes.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Education, or similar related disciplines and/or a combination of training, experience, and education.

• 5 or more years of technical training experience in an industrial and/or manufacturing setting

• Significant experience creating technical training curriculums and programs

• Ability to plan, manage time, and multitask effectively

• Advanced database and computer skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Advanced record-keeping skills

• Good decision-making, problem-solving, collaboration and teamwork skills

• Leadership and motivational skills are a plus

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Ireland’s essential water and industrial infrastructure rely on the expertise and responsiveness of Sulzer’s service teams. As our Irish business continues to grow, we’re strengthening our commercial and technical capability with a newly created Tendering Engineer role—sitting at the centre of proposal development, technical evaluation, and securing future work across our service and aftermarket operations. This is your opportunity to become a key link between engineering, customers, and suppliers, helping shape technically sound and commercially competitive solutions.

Working in a blended model (office, home, and site/customer visits) and based in either Dublin or Wexford, you will take ownership of the full tendering lifecycle. This will include reviewing customer requirements, carrying out technical assessments (including pump selection and sizing), building accurate costings, and coordinating with internal teams and external suppliers to develop high-quality proposals. As demand continues to grow and with evolving customer needs, this role is critical in supporting business expansion, securing new opportunities, and ensuring we maintain a strong technical and commercial offering across Ireland. Key Duties

• Take ownership of the end-to-end tendering process for service and equipment opportunities

• Review client specifications and translate requirements into practical, engineered solutions

• Carry out pump selection, sizing, and technical evaluations to ensure optimal performance and compliance

• Prepare detailed technical and commercial proposals, ensuring accuracy and competitiveness

• Liaise with internal engineering, service teams, and external suppliers to build robust submissions

• Engage with customers to clarify requirements and support pre‑tender discussions where needed

• Analyse cost structures, risks, and margins to support sustainable business growth

• Maintain and improve tendering processes, tools, and technical documentation

• Support knowledge sharing across engineering, service, and commercial teams

What We’re Looking For

We’re seeking someone with a strong technical grounding in rotating equipment and a commercial mindset. You’ll be comfortable interpreting technical requirements, engaging with stakeholders, and translating engineering detail into winning proposals.
You should bring:

• Experience with pumps and rotating equipment (selection, sizing, or application knowledge highly desirable)

• Background in tendering, proposals, applications engineering, or a related technical-commercial role

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop costings and evaluate technical solutions

• Experience working within industrial, water, or process environments

• Ability to interpret specifications, drawings, and performance data

• Strong communication skills, with confidence engaging customers and internal teams

• A proactive, detail-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple tenders simultaneously

What we offer you

As part of a global engineering group with over 160 locations worldwide and a multi‑billion‑franc annual turnover, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, innovate, and shape your career within a truly international organisation.

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working with defined core hours

• Generous annual leave allowance

• Strong pension scheme

• Free on‑site parking and EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Enhanced family‑friendly leave policies

• Access to structured learning and development pathways

• Genuine opportunities for global mobility and long‑term progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo L’acqua essenziale dell’Irlanda e l’infrastruttura industriale si affidano all’esperienza e alla reattività dei team di assistenza di Sulzer. Mentre il nostro business irlandese continua a crescere, stiamo rafforzando la nostra capacità commerciale e tecnica con un nuovo ruolo di Ingegnere di Tendering, che si trova al centro dello sviluppo di proposte, della valutazione tecnica, e di garantire il lavoro futuro attraverso il nostro servizio e le operazioni di aftermarket. Questa è la tua occasione per diventare un collegamento chiave tra ingegneria, clienti e fornitori, aiutando a modellare soluzioni tecnicamente solide e commercialmente competitive. Lavorando in un modello misto (ufficio, casa e visite di sito/cliente) e con sede a Dublino o Wexford, si prenderanno la proprietà del ciclo di vita completo di tendering. Ciò includerà la revisione dei requisiti del cliente, l'esecuzione di valutazioni tecniche (compresa la selezione delle pompe e il dimensionamento), la costruzione di costi accurati, e il coordinamento con team interni e fornitori esterni per sviluppare proposte di alta qualità. Poiché la domanda continua a crescere e con l'evoluzione delle esigenze dei clienti, questo ruolo è fondamentale nel sostenere l'espansione aziendale, nel garantire nuove opportunità, e assicurandoci di mantenere una forte offerta tecnica e commerciale in tutta l'Irlanda. Doveri chiave
• Assumere la proprietà del processo di appalto end-to-end per opportunità di assistenza e attrezzature
• Verificare le specifiche del cliente e tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni pratiche e ingegnerizzate
• Eseguire la selezione della pompa, il dimensionamento e le valutazioni tecniche per garantire prestazioni e conformità ottimali
• Preparare proposte tecniche e commerciali dettagliate, garantendo precisione e competitività
• Liaise con l'ingegneria interna, i team di assistenza e i fornitori esterni per costruire presentazioni robuste
• Impegnarsi con i clienti per chiarire i requisiti e sostenere le discussioni pre-tender laddove necessario
• Analizzare le strutture dei costi, i rischi e i margini per sostenere la crescita sostenibile delle imprese
• Mantenere e migliorare i processi di appalto, gli strumenti e la documentazione tecnica
• Supporta la condivisione delle conoscenze tra team di ingegneria, servizio e commerciali Cosa stiamo cercando Stiamo cercando qualcuno con una forte messa a terra tecnica in attrezzature rotanti e una mentalità commerciale. Sarete a vostro agio a interpretare i requisiti tecnici, coinvolgendo con le parti interessate, e traducendo dettagli ingegneristici in proposte vincenti. Dovresti portare:
• Esperienza con pompe e attrezzature rotanti (selezione, dimensionamento o conoscenza delle applicazioni altamente auspicabile)
• Sfondo dell'offerta, delle proposte, dell'ingegneria delle applicazioni o di un ruolo tecnico-commerciale
• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di sviluppare costi e valutare soluzioni tecniche
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti industriali, acquatici o di processo
• Capacità di interpretare specifiche, disegni e dati delle prestazioni
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con fiducia coinvolgendo clienti e team interni
• Un approccio proattivo e dettagliato, con la capacità di gestire più gare contemporaneamente Cosa ti offriamo Nell’ambito di un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 160 sedi in tutto il mondo e un fatturato annuo multi-milioni-franco, avrai l’opportunità di crescere, innovare e plasmare la tua carriera all’interno di un’organizzazione veramente internazionale.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle L'Irlande compte sur l'expertise et la réactivité des équipes de service de Sulzer. Au fur et à mesure que notre activité en Irlande continue de croître, nous renforçons notre capacité commerciale et technique avec un nouveau rôle d'ingénieur d'appel d'offres – en étant au centre de l'élaboration de propositions, de l'évaluation technique et en assurant des travaux futurs dans nos activités de service et de post-marché. C'est l'occasion de devenir un lien clé entre l'ingénierie, les clients et les fournisseurs, aidant à façonner des solutions techniquement saines et commercialement compétitives. Travaillant dans un modèle mixte (bureau, domicile, visites de site/client) et basé à Dublin ou Wexford, vous serez propriétaire du cycle de vie complet de l'appel d'offres. Il s'agira notamment d'examiner les besoins des clients, d'effectuer des évaluations techniques (y compris la sélection et le calibrage des pompes), d'établir des coûts précis et de coordonner l'élaboration de propositions de haute qualité avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs externes. Au fur et à mesure que la demande continue de croître et que les besoins des clients évoluent, ce rôle est essentiel pour soutenir l'expansion des entreprises, obtenir de nouvelles possibilités et nous assurer de maintenir une offre technique et commerciale solide dans toute l'Irlande. Principales fonctions
• Prendre en charge le processus d'appel d'offres de bout en bout pour les possibilités de service et d'équipement
• Examiner les spécifications du client et traduire les exigences en solutions pratiques et conçues
• Effectuer la sélection des pompes, le calibrage et les évaluations techniques pour assurer une performance et une conformité optimales
• Préparer des propositions techniques et commerciales détaillées, garantissant l'exactitude et la compétitivité
• Assurer la liaison avec l'ingénierie interne, les équipes de services et les fournisseurs externes pour construire des soumissions robustes
• S'engager auprès des clients pour clarifier les exigences et soutenir les discussions pré-tendance au besoin
• Analyser les structures de coûts, les risques et les marges pour soutenir la croissance durable des entreprises

jobs.title: Interim Payroll Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is seeking an experienced Interim Payroll Implementation Specialist to support the transition of UK payroll operations into a streamlined shared services model using Strada.
You will lead the review, standardisation, and implementation of payroll processes across 7 legal entities (c.1300 employees), ensuring a compliant, efficient, and scalable solution. Sulzer is seeking an experienced Interim Payroll Implementation Specialist to support the transition of UK payroll operations into a streamlined shared services model using Strada.
You will lead the review, standardisation, and implementation of payroll processes across 7 legal entities (c.1300 employees), ensuring a compliant, efficient, and scalable solution.

Key Responsibilities

• Assess current payroll processes, identifying risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities to standardise

• Streamline and align processes to a shared services operating model

• Lead end-to-end payroll implementation (configuration, data migration, parallel runs, and go-live)

• Ensure compliance with UK payroll legislation (HMRC)

• Deliver change management, stakeholder engagement, and training

• Provide post-go-live (“hypercare”) support to ensure stability

• Support governance, controls, and continuous improvement

• About You

• Proven payroll implementation or transformation experience

• Strong multi-entity payroll expertise

• Experience driving process standardisation and improvements

• Knowledge of UK payroll legislation

• Experience with Strada (Workday desirable)

• Strong stakeholder management and project delivery skills

• Qualifications & Experience

• CIPP qualification (or equivalent) OR significant payroll experience

Why Join?

This is a high-impact role where you will drive excellence and help streamline payroll operations during a key transformation programme.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Jr. Logistics Officer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Junior Logistics Officer da soporte a las operaciones logísticas, incluyendo transporte, almacén y seguimiento de inventario, contribuyendo a garantizar un flujo eficiente de mercancías y materiales.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales junior que, bajo supervisión, aplican conocimientos teóricos básicos y desarrollan sus capacidades analíticas para la resolución de problemas, en colaboración con perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales

• Coordinar el transporte y la entrega de mercancías (nacional e internacional)

• Dar soporte a procesos de importación/exportación y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo

• Realizar el seguimiento de envíos y mantener actualizados los sistemas logísticos

• Preparar documentación de envío (facturas, packing lists, documentación aduanera, etc.)

• Apoyar en la gestión de pedidos internos y expediciones

• Comunicarse con proveedores, transportistas y equipos internos

• Monitorizar niveles de inventario y dar soporte a operaciones de almacén

• Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos logísticos y optimización de costes

Requisitos

• Formación Profesional o Grado en Logística, Supply Chain o similar

• Hasta 2 años de experiencia relevante (incluyendo prácticas)

• Conocimientos básicos de importación/exportación y procedimientos aduaneros

• Manejo de herramientas de gestión logística y Microsoft Office

Competencias

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y organización

• Atención al detalle y capacidad analítica

• Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y cumplir plazos

• Actitud proactiva y orientación al trabajo en equipo

Idiomas

• Inglés: nivel B2 (intermedio-alto)

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinid o.

• Salario competitivo, así como participación en un sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y financieros.

• Ticket restaurante.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo: seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Un buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y consolidada.

• Incorporación a una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

• Ubicación de las oficinas: RIVAS

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about engineering and looking for an exciting opportunity to grow your career? We have a vacancy at our Wexford Service Centre for a Service Engineer to join our dedicated team. This role involves servicing and installing industrial, municipal, and commercial wastewater and stormwater pumping equipment. Key Responsibilities:

• Planned Inspections & Maintenance : Conduct effective planned inspections, fault finding, and maintenance of pumping equipment at customer sites.

• Ownership & Initiative : Take an active role and ownership of your responsibilities.

• Technical Expertise : Demonstrate strong skills in the service and repair of wastewater equipment.

• Reporting : Complete repair, service, and technical reports accurately and timely.

• Work Environment : Support the company's drive to create a better working environment.

• Client Communication : Communicate effectively and liaise with our client base to ensure satisfaction and service excellence.

What We Are Looking For:

• Mechanical Ability : Strong mechanical skills and aptitude.

• Health & Safety : A dedicated approach to health and safety practices.

• Computer Skills : Proficiency in computer skills for reporting and communication.

• Interpersonal Skills : Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

• Team Player : Ability to work alone or as part of a team, under pressure and to deadlines.

• Attention to Detail : Excellent attention to detail in all aspects of the role

• Applicants must hold a full manual driving license. Automatic‑only licenses cannot be accepted for this role.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary based on experience.

• An interesting and rewarding position with opportunities for career progression.

• Performance related bonus scheme related to personal and company performance paid end Q1 each year.

• Defined contribution pension scheme.

• Access to our Employee Assistance Programme.

• Additional ongoing training to enhance your skills.

• A real opportunity to grow your career with a global engineering company

• Working hours Mon-Fri hours 8:30-5:00 with flexi time depending on workloads.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SERVICE ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Field Service Engineer es responsable de la instalación, puesta en marcha, mantenimiento y reparación de equipos técnicos tanto en taller como en las instalaciones de cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales o intermedias de su carrera, que aplican conocimientos técnicos en entornos reales, analizan incidencias y proponen soluciones bajo la supervisión y coordinación de perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales

• Ejecutar trabajos de instalación, puesta en marcha, mantenimiento y reparación de equipos en instalaciones de cliente y/o en taller

• Diagnosticar averías y resolver incidencias técnicas mecánicas y eléctricas

• Realizar tareas de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo

• Apoyar en el montaje y desmontaje de equipos y sistemas

• Colaborar en la supervisión de instalaciones realizadas por proveedores externos

• Interpretar planos técnicos, manuales y despieces

• Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, seguridad y medioambiente

• Documentar las intervenciones realizadas y reportar incidencias

• Colaborar con equipos comerciales y técnicos en visitas a cliente cuando sea necesario

Requisitos

• Formación Profesional de Grado Medio o Superior en Electromecánica, Mecánica, Electricidad o similar

• Experiencia inicial o hasta 2-3 años en entornos industriales o de mantenimiento

• Conocimientos mecánicos y eléctricos (valorable hidráulica)

• Capacidad para interpretar planos y documentación técnica

• Manejo básico de herramientas informáticas (MS Office)

• Carnet de conducir y disponibilidad para desplazamientos

Competencias

• Atención al detalle y orientación a la calidad

• Capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas técnicos

• Habilidad para trabajar de forma estructurada y metódica

• Autonomía, responsabilidad y orientación a resultados

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo

• Compromiso con la seguridad en el trabajo

What we offer you

• Contrato indefinido.

• Salario competitivo y participación en el sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y corporativos.

• Ticket restaurantes.

• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo, seguro médico, transporte, guardería).

• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.

• Buen ambiente de trabajo.

• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y con fuerte presencia global.

• Formar parte de una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.

• Ubicación de la oficina: SEVILLA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

El/La Sales Engineer (Industrial) da soporte al proceso comercial aportando conocimiento técnico, participando en la preparación de propuestas y colaborando en la definición de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente.

Esta posición está orientada a profesionales en etapas iniciales de su carrera, que combinan interés por la ingeniería y las ventas, analizan requisitos técnicos y contribuyen al desarrollo de oportunidades comerciales, trabajando en coordinación con equipos senior y otras áreas.

Ámbito de actuación: España y Portugal. Responsabilidades principales

• Apoyar en la preparación y presentación de propuestas técnico-comerciales

• Colaborar en el diseño de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades del cliente

• Dar soporte en reuniones y visitas comerciales con clientes

• Responder a consultas técnicas y comerciales, actuando como interlocutor de soporte

• Coordinarse con equipos de ingeniería y operaciones para asegurar la viabilidad de las propuestas

• Realizar seguimiento de ofertas y oportunidades comerciales

• Mantener actualizada la información de clientes y actividad comercial en el CRM

• Analizar el mercado y la competencia para identificar oportunidades de negocio

• Contribuir a la implementación de la estrategia comercial en el área asignada

Requisitos

• Grado universitario en Ingeniería (Industrial o similar) o formación equivalente

• Hasta 2 años de experiencia en entornos técnicos o comerciales

• Interés por el ámbito técnico-comercial en sector industrial

• Manejo de herramientas Microsoft Office y CRM (valorable Salesforce)

• Disponibilidad para viajar dentro de España y Portugal

Competencias

• Orientación al cliente y buenas habilidades de comunicación

• Capacidad analítica y de comprensión técnica

• Proactividad, iniciativa y actitud de aprendizaje

• Habilidades de organización y seguimiento

• Flexibilidad y adaptación a entornos dinámicos

jobs.title: Sales Engineer- Mining
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Sales Engineer is responsible for driving sales growth and expanding Sulzer’s market presence within the mining sector.

The role combines strong technical understanding with commercial execution to position Sulzer as the preferred OEM partner for reliability, performance, and lifecycle value, while actively engaging with end users, EPCMs, consultants, and channel partners, particularly in greenfield and brownfield projects. Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Sales Growth

• Identify and secure new business opportunities in mining (open-pit and underground operations)

• Develop and execute strategic account plans for key mining customers

• Meet and exceed sales targets, order intake, and profitability objectives

2. Technical & Solution-Based Selling

• Develop and propose fit-for-purpose pump solutions aligned with customer operational requirements

• Support customers with:
• Equipment selection guidance

• System optimisation recommendations

• Performance improvement initiatives
